Three production findings (`F255`, `F256`, `F257`), one taught sentence, one record flush/row, and the post-close reachability drive. Ceremony tier **T2** per the spec's `Constraints`.
**Precedents, and what carries.** From `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-TEACH-PLAN-DRIVES-CORRECTIONS-2-1E59AEAA/plan.xml` this plan carries: the flush-first committed sequence with a `--rewrite-roots` after every live-root hand write; the flush-invariant and payment-invariant walks in the house form already in `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` (`expectFlushedFindingInvariants`, `walkCftRow`/`expectCftRowInvariants` and the `C-TEACH-PLAN-DRIVES-CORRECTIONS-2-1E59AEAA flush invariant` describe at `:5386`); the `bundleMinted` payer-derivation extension; the needle-first teaching pair with a red-direction case per added needle; the pass-only closing task carrying the plan's single `Satisfies` and the faithful whole-repository post-close copy drive; and the `git diff --exit-code BASE -- …` byte-invariance mirrors of the spec's pathset. What does **not** carry: that plan's `src/`-write-free shape (this bundle writes three `src/` production files) and its two-task split (this plan separates the three independent production fixes so each keeps its own signature budget). From `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-PAIR-AUDIT-MINT-CWD-1-ED6B7D22/plan.xml` this plan carries: one red-first pair per production fix, the red a failing assertion in the surface's own suite, the interleaved fail-in-its-own-tool-round-trip → fix → pass ordering, the post-close drive that reaches the applied-archive state with `apply --force`, and the `CloseEvidence` extraction from the spec's own bytes through `sh -lc`. What does not carry: its module list and its five-task budget, because the fixes here are three different files in three different modules.
**The red-first pairs, driven on whole-repository prototype copies from `9fa797d` (the approval commit differs from the spec's base `3844741` only under the bundle's own directory).** Every drive below was executed on a throwaway copy; the production record and bundle were never mutated. | Task | Pair key | Red (driven) | Pass (driven) | |---|---|---|---| | T-001 | `flush-invariant` | `bun test --timeout=30000 scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` **123 pass / 1 fail** (the walk, elements absent) | flush + `--rewrite-roots`, **124 / 0**; roots `7567 / 229 / 7796`, index `271 / 25 / 296` | | T-001 | `record-row` | same suite **124 pass / 1 fail** (the row walk, row absent) | row mint + `--rewrite-roots`, **125 / 0**; registry `13 / 13 / 26`; validators 0 | | T-002 | `explain-fallback` | `bun test --timeout=30000 src/grace-lint.test.ts` **111 pass / 4 fail** (the three branch tests and the JSON-shape test) | the `--explain` rewrite, **115 / 0**; `bun run typecheck` 0 | | T-003 | `anchor-injective` | `bun test --timeout=30000 src/review/core.test.ts` **184 pass / 4 fail** (the four injectivity cases) | the four key discriminators, **188 / 0**; determinism chain 0 (196 tests, ratchet ok 14) | | T-004 | `commands-line` | `bun test --timeout=30000 src/lint/core.test.ts` **25 pass / 1 fail** (the green-report test) | the module-private capture + report line, **26 / 0** | | T-005 | `teaching-needle` | `bun ./scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts check` **exit 1**, `missing token "codes are namespaced"` | sentence in both trees, check **0**; teaching suite **59 / 0**; footprint **9 / 0**; marketplace **0** | | T-006 | `post-close-drive` | pass-only (a verification drive has no red to record) | the post-close applied-archive drive over every `CloseEvidence` command |
The reds are the spec's own red directions (`AC-EXPLAIN-FALLBACK`, `AC-EXPLAIN-JSON`, `AC-ANCHOR-INJECTIVE`, `AC-COMMANDS-REPORTED`, `AC-TAUGHT-SENTENCES`, the flush and row walks), not manufactured failures.
**Row 4's trap, decided.** `unknown-shape` (`src/grace-lint.ts:256`), `must-exist:${target}` (`src/review/core.ts:548`) and the absence of a `Commands:` line are things this bundle **flips**, so they are **test reds, never `BaselineAssertions` needles**. A baseline `MustContain` of `kind: "unknown-shape"` would be false after T-002 and a baseline `MustNotContain` of `unknown-code-or-shape` would be false before it — the flipped spelling belongs to the target or to a test. The baseline honestly pins only what the bundle leaves unchanged: the four modules and their shipped files, shipped spellings that stay (`isRegisteredSchemaShape`, `findingId`, `baselineExpectationCounts`, `GOVERNED_SKILLS`, `rewritten wholesale`, `bundleMinted`) and the shipped-green commands at `3844741` (`src/grace-lint.test.ts` 111/0, `src/review/core.test.ts` 184/0, `src/lint/core.test.ts` 23/0, the teaching/record/token suites, the three validators, `validate:marketplace`, `validate:determinism`, `validate:ci`). No baseline `MustNotContain` is used at all: every spelling this bundle flips is a target or a test assertion.
**The D13 mechanism, and the pinned bytes it must not move.** `src/lint/core.ts:79` (`baselineExpectationCounts`) and `:87` (`asStateScratchByResult`) are the module-private `WeakMap<LintResult, …>` pattern the spec's F257 Constraint names; the capture attaches on the `onCommandRun` path (`:494`–`:510`), which is the same path that calls `appendCommandRunEvent`. `formatTextReport` (`:780`) reads the new `commandRunRecordsByResult` WeakMap and appends `Commands: <N> evaluated, <M> exit 0` after the `Warnings:` line (and after the `asState` line when present), before the `Issues`/`No issues found.` block. A throwaway implementation on a copy (T-004's prototype) was driven to prove the green is producible.
**The F256 ordinal source, and the corpus check.** The discriminator is **document order among that rule's emits in the file**: a per-file 0-based counter incremented on each emit (`marker:${marker}#<n>`, `must-exist:${target}#<n>`, `must-match:${file}#<n>`, `vm-child:${node.tag}:${child.tag}#<n>`), so two runs of one tree agree. The prototype drove `bun run typecheck` 0 and `bun ./src/grace.ts lint --path .` clean with the imports in place. No catalog entry changes, so `M-LINT-CATALOG` stays out of scope.
**Scope (row 6).** `ObservedWriteScope` names every path `WriteEvidence` will digest: the seven `src/` files (three production, three test, the test-support pin), the skill and its packaged mirror, the three `scripts/` files, `README.md`, and the five record files the flush and the close write. `.ngrace/` lifecycle paths (this bundle's own `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`) are F11-exempt and are not declared — the review skips the bundle's own artifacts by identity. `DurableScope` carries the spec's four `AffectedAreas` modules and their four `V-M-*` peers; no `OutOfPlanScope` entry is needed.

**Zero current-mode `<Command>`s.** `AC-NO-CURRENT-MODE` is this plan's single `Satisfies`-mapped criterion, carried by T-006; no task `Verification` command or `TargetAssertions` entry contains `--assertions current` or a lint of this root omitting `--assertions` (`grep -c '<Command>bun ./src/grace.ts lint --path .' plan.xml` is 0). The close's post-archive 0/0 lint is the authority's `AC-CLOSE-LINT`.
**The close is the authority's act.** No task performs `terminal`, `fold`, the close's `review`, a verdict, `gate apply`, `gate archive`, `ngrace apply`, the close's `--retire`, any production `CloseEvidence` run, or the archive move. T-001 leaves `f255`, `f256`, `f257` and the row **live** with `--rewrite-roots` applied; T-002..T-004 leave their suites green; T-005 leaves the sentence in both trees and the footprint re-measured; T-006 drives the post-close copy and leaves the production bundle active, its plan still `draft`. Findings raised while this bundle is open go to `.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` under the next staged number (`D30`).
**Why six tasks.** Each fix is a different file in a different module and gets its own red-first pair; the record gets two interleaved pairs; the teaching gets one; the verification is pass-only.
